messages.name: Prestige Worldwide admin
messages.body: Does InvoicePilot match bank transactions automatically? We're on 2.2.1.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: Auto-match was added in 2.3.0. On 2.2.1, reconcile manually: match each transaction to an invoice or expense, or categorize it. You'll get auto-match automatically when you move to 2.3.x.

messages.name: Prestige Worldwide admin
messages.body: That's not great, but we'll use the workaround.
